import os, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

from android.tools.tests.test_verify_tools import ADB_BODY, MAESTRO_BODY, write_exe
with TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
 root=Path(directory); (root/'bin').mkdir(); (root/'flow.yaml').write_text('appId: smoke.fixture\n---\n- launchApp\n')
 write_exe(root/'bin/maestro',MAESTRO_BODY); write_exe(root/'bin/adb',ADB_BODY)
 env={**os.environ,'PATH':'bin'+os.pathsep+os.environ.get('PATH',''),'PYTHONPATH':str(Path.cwd()),'MAESTRO_FAKE_RESULT':'pass'}
 def run(*args,extra=None):
  proc=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','android.tools',*args],cwd=root,env={**env,**(extra or {})},text=True,capture_output=True)

  assert code==1,(case,code,stdout,stderr); outcomes[case]=code
